meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: Claude 会按代码的语法结构(而非文字)搜索和改写 25 种语言的代码,比如把 console.log 批量换成 logger.info,或执行 YAML 规则;改写前先给出试运行预览。
howto.when: 当你要找或改写某种语法结构(如某形状的函数、调用、import),而不是具体字符串时触发;纯文本、注释或文件名请改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: search 子命令列出匹配位置,不改文件

say.text: 扫描 src/ 下的 YAML 规则并报告违规

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. It finds calls, classes or imports shaped like X, applies codemods such as console.log → logger.info, and runs YAML rules. Rewrites default to a dry-run preview.
howto.when_en: Use when the target is a syntax shape (a function, call or import of a given form) rather than literal text; for strings, comments or filenames use rg.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: search lists matches; no files change

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x) — dry run first
Scan src/ for YAML rule violations
